_comment: Mutation kill-rate thresholds, read by BOTH gate scripts: scripts/check_mutation_gate.py
(mutmut, over src/hooks/) and scripts-ts/checkMutationGate.ts (Stryker, over scripts-ts/).
Single-sourced on purpose — two runtimes each hardcoding 90/95 is exactly how the two gates
drift apart, and a project that gates itself at >= 90% must not have two answers to what 90
means. tests-ts/mutationGate.spec.ts and tests/test_mutation_gate.py both read this file, so
a change here moves both gates or fails both suites.
